description: Two-arm generalisation experiment on the tasks the proposer never saw. Same runner, same protocol shape and same model as the canonical pass-rate experiment, so the two numbers are directly comparable — the only difference is the task set.
notes: These tasks are excluded from every channel the proposer reads: the search task set it benchmarks against, the branch artifacts its prompt points at, and the prompt itself. tests/test_holdout_isolation.py checks each channel.
trials_per_task x 5 tasks x 2 arms = 100 task trials.
A holdout delta below the search-set delta is the expected shape of the result, not a failure: the search set is what the harness was evolved against.
